conventions.convention: Category O is BGG category O for a fixed finite-dimensional complex semisimple Lie algebra and chosen positive system. The tensor-space route uses the degenerate affine Hecke action, with right action obtained through the generator-fixing anti-involution.
The source normalization is y_j = x_j − z_M/N + (N−1)/2, where z_M is the central endomorphism acting on the module factor.
The nondegenerate Hecke parameter ξ is independent of the grading variable q. The finite cyclic bridge requires e ≥ 2; its degenerate parameter-one branch requires characteristic e.
The one-strand example uses charge-zero level-one weight Λ₀, content α₀, and the standard homogeneous first-strand cyclotomic quotient.
The nondegenerate quadratic relation is T_i² = (ξ−1)T_i + ξ; at ξ = −1 it becomes T_i² = −2T_i−1.

load_bearing.statement: This route convention introduces no new theorem, grading, equivalence, or cross-characteristic transfer.
